key_phrases: Ray tracing will be the standard
analysis.reasoning: The overall sentiment is cautiously optimistic. While the company faced a significant year-on-year revenue decline (31%) and a 'pause' in hyperscale data center spending, management focused heavily on the long-term structural growth of AI, inference, and the RTX ecosystem. Confidence is high regarding technology leadership (moat) and innovation (momentum), though forward guidance was intentionally conservative ('returning to quarterly guidance') due to low visibility in the data center segment. The acquisition of Mellanox is a major strategic highlight. Quantitative specificity was high with detailed revenue breakdowns by segment. Risk disclosure was moderate, primarily focusing on the hyperscale spending pause and CPU shortages affecting gaming laptops.
